facts.fact: PowerCom bases its fibre market estimate on the 2023 Population and Housing Census, which it says recorded 414,119 urban households.

NAM.note: PowerCom's open-access fibre is an operator's commercial funding ask with no government programme; broadband penetration below 35% is a national figure with no rural and urban split.
Only fibre to homes and buildings is described, not a long-distance backbone.
